short_description: Linux kernels before 5.15.208 / 6.1.174 / 6.6.141 / 6.12.91 / 6.18.33 / 7.0.10 lose the SKBFL_SHARED_FRAG marker when TCP receive coalescing merges paged fragments, so ESP (IPsec) input processing can decrypt in place over page-cache-backed fragments and silently modify page-cache data (CVE-2026-46300); exploited in the wild chained with the PHP2Shell RCEs to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.
title: Linux kernel page-cache corruption via lost shared-fragment marker in skb coalescing (CVE-2026-46300)
